qualification: Separate instrumented32worker all-nine complete SDK runs, four calls including three primes. Capacity events perturb scheduling and cannot establish an uninstrumented maximum. Summed per-queue maxima are an observed storage envelope, not simultaneous allocator peak. OFF accounting omits epoch-retired arrays, so it is not a retained-vs-normal physical-memory comparison. Counts exclude pointed-to job payloads, allocator/Arc/Inner/thread storage and all prover allocations. No speed claim or pressure/universal-memory qualification.
